sentences.text: The second season of the South Korean reality television competition show K-pop Star premiered on SBS on November 18 , 2012 , airing Sunday evenings at 4:55 pm KST as part of the Good Sunday lineup .	SBS	Seoul Broadcasting System	reality television	reality television	K-pop Star	K-pop Star	KST	Korea Standard Time	Good Sunday	Good Sunday
Yoon Do-hyun returned as host and narrator , and Boom returned as live host .	Yoon Do-hyun	Yoon Do-hyun	Boom	Boom (entertainer)
Yang Hyun-suk , Park Jin-young , and BoA returned as judges .	BoA	BoA	Park Jin-young	Park Jin-young	Yang Hyun-suk	Yang Hyun-Seok
The season ended on April 6 , 2013 , with Akdong Musician crowned as winner and chose to sign with YG Entertainment .	Akdong Musician	Akdong Musician	YG Entertainment	YG Entertainment
Contestants from the Top 10 of Season 2 returned for a special Dream Stage - Best of the Best episode on April 14 , 2013 , competing with contestants of Season 1 for the title of Overall Champion .
